function.name: check_availability
function.description: Finds open roof inspection times. Call it with no inputs for the earliest openings. If the lead named a day, pass preferred_date (YYYY-MM-DD) and, if they said morning or afternoon, time_of_day. Returns match, slots (each with spoken text and exact start) and a note. Only offer times it returns.

time_of_day.description: Optional. morning or afternoon if the lead said so, otherwise any.

preferred_date.description: Optional. The day the lead asked for, as YYYY-MM-DD, worked out from today's date. Leave out if the lead did not name a day.
